text: Cycling is an efficient and environmentally friendly way to travel, requiring no fuel and producing no carbon emissions. It enhances cardiovascular health and builds strength and endurance. For safety, most experienced cyclists wear a helmet when cycling, especially when riding on roads or in traffic. Helmets protect the head from serious head injuries, making it a critical safety equipment for cyclists. As the sport grows in popularity, riders are also increasingly investing in quality cycling gear, focusing on comfort, durability, and performance. As the sport advances, the importance of gears in cycling has grown, allowing cyclists to control speed and energy expenditure effectively during various terrains and conditions.
